name: Forgiving Self
overview: Scripture reveals that God fully removes our transgressions as far as the east is from the west, cleansing us completely from sin despite its scarlet stain. This divine forgiveness is conditioned on our willingness to forgive others, reflecting the heart of God who invites us to reason together and be made pure as snow. Love covers all sins and wisdom guards our hearts, enabling us to extend grace both outwardly and inwardly. Thus, forgiving oneself is rooted in embracing God's forgiveness and walking in the love and mercy He commands.
